"GREEN EMPIRE – A BREAKING BAD INSPIRED TYCOON

Create an addictive mobile game inspired by Weed Firm, combined with the atmosphere, storytelling and criminal-business themes of Breaking Bad.

VISUAL STYLE

- 2.5D isometric perspective.
- Fixed angled top-down camera.
- Colourful cartoon-style characters and detailed environments.
- Visible rooms, furniture, equipment and animated characters.
- Similar visual gameplay presentation to Weed Firm.
- NOT first-person or realistic 3D.

STORY

You start as a struggling nobody with a tiny apartment and a small cannabis-growing operation.

Inspired by Breaking Bad, your journey takes you from an ordinary small-time dealer to a powerful underground business kingpin.

Create an original storyline featuring interesting characters, shady business partners, rival organisations, unexpected betrayals and dangerous decisions.

CORE GAMEPLAY

- Grow and harvest different cannabis strains.
- Manage product quality and inventory.
- Serve customers and complete orders.
- Earn money and reinvest profits.
- Upgrade growing equipment and facilities.
- Expand your apartment into larger operations.
- Hire employees and unlock new characters.
- Purchase new properties and businesses.

BREAKING BAD THEMES

Introduce:

- Chemistry-inspired production mechanics.
- Secret laboratories and industrial warehouses.
- Suspicious business partners.
- Police investigations and rising suspicion.
- Money laundering through legitimate businesses.
- Rival criminal organisations.
- Story-driven missions and character interactions.
- Risk versus reward decisions.
- Unexpected events and betrayals.

PROGRESSION

Start in a tiny apartment and gradually unlock:

1. Small apartment.
2. Garage operation.
3. Underground laboratory.
4. Industrial warehouse.
5. Multiple properties.
6. A massive criminal business empire.

GAME FEATURES

- Money and inventory management.
- Customer reputation.
- Product quality and pricing.
- Equipment upgrades.
- Employee management.
- Unlockable characters.
- Police heat system.
- Story missions.
- Save and load functionality.

Make every room interactive and visually alive, with animated characters, growing plants and customers.

MOST IMPORTANT

Prioritise a working playable game over complicated features.

Build the core gameplay loop first: grow, harvest, sell, earn, upgrade and expand.

The result should feel like Weed Firm gameplay meets the gritty criminal-business atmosphere of Breaking Bad, with original characters and its own unique story.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

playwright-cli - run playwright mcp commands from terminal

Usage: playwright-cli <command> [args] [options]
Usage: playwright-cli -s=<session> <command> [args] [options]

Core:
  open [url]                  open the browser
  attach [name]               attach to a running playwright browser
  close                       close the browser
  detach                      detach from an attached browser
  goto <url>                  navigate to a url
  type <text>                 type text into editable element
  click <target> [button]     perform click on a web page
  dblclick <target> [button]  perform double click on a web page
  fill <target> <text>        fill text into editable element
  drag <startTarget> <endTarget> perform drag and drop between two elements
  drop <target>               drop files or data onto an element
  hover <target>              hover over element on page
  select <target> <val>       select an option in a dropdown
  upload <files...>           upload one or multiple files
  check <target>              check a checkbox or radio button
  uncheck <target>            uncheck a checkbox or radio button
  snapshot [target]           capture page snapshot to obtain element ref
  find [text]                 search the page snapshot for text or a regexp, returning matching nodes with surrounding context (like search snippets)
  eval <func> [target]        evaluate javascript expression on page or element
  dialog-accept [prompt]      accept a dialog
  dialog-dismiss              dismiss a dialog
  resize <w> <h>              resize the browser window
  delete-data                 delete session data

Navigation:
  go-back                     go back to the previous page
  go-forward                  go forward to the next page
  reload                      reload the current page

Keyboard:
  press <key>                 press a key on the keyboard, `a`, `arrowleft`
  keydown <key>               press a key down on the keyboard
  keyup <key>                 press a key up on the keyboard

Mouse:
  mousemove <x> <y>           move mouse to a given position
  mousedown [button]          press mouse down
  mouseup [button]            press mouse up
  mousewheel <dx> <dy>        scroll mouse wheel

Save as:
  screenshot [target]         screenshot of the current page or element
  pdf                         save page as pdf

Tabs:
  tab-list                    list all tabs
  tab-new [url]               create a new tab
  tab-close [index]           close a browser tab
  tab-select <index>          select a browser tab

Storage:
  state-load <filename>       loads browser storage (authentication) state from a file
  state-save [filename]       saves the current storage (authentication) state to a file
  cookie-list                 list all cookies (optionally filtered by domain/path)
  cookie-get <name>           get a specific cookie by name
  cookie-set <name> <value>   set a cookie with optional flags
  cookie-delete <name>        delete a specific cookie
  cookie-clear                clear all cookies
  localstorage-list           list all localstorage key-value pairs
  localstorage-get <key>      get a localstorage item by key
  localstorage-set <key> <value> set a localstorage item
  localstorage-delete <key>   delete a localstorage item
  localstorage-clear          clear all localstorage
  sessionstorage-list         list all sessionstorage key-value pairs
  sessionstorage-get <key>    get a sessionstorage item by key
  sessionstorage-set <key> <value> set a sessionstorage item
  sessionstorage-delete <key> delete a sessionstorage item
  sessionstorage-clear        clear all sessionstorage

Network:
  requests                    list all network requests since loading the page. each request is numbered for use with the `request` command.
  request <index>             show full details (headers, body, response) of a single network request by its number from the `requests` command.
  request-headers <index>     print only the request headers for a single network request by its number from the `requests` command.
  request-body <index>        print only the request body for a single network request by its number from the `requests` command.
  response-headers <index>    print only the response headers for a single network request by its number from the `requests` command.
  response-body <index>       print the response body for a single network request by its number from the `requests` command. textual bodies are inlined; binary bodies are saved to a file and the path is printed.
  route <pattern>             mock network requests matching a url pattern
  route-list                  list all active network routes
  unroute [pattern]           remove routes matching a pattern (or all routes)
  network-state-set <state>   set the browser network state to online or offline

DevTools:
  console [min-level]         list console messages
  run-code [code]             run playwright code snippet
  recording-start             start recording user actions
  recording-stop              stop recording user actions and print them as playwright code
  tracing-start               start trace recording
  tracing-stop                stop trace recording
  video-start [filename]      start video recording

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable mobile-friendly tycoon game inspired by Weed Firm’s isometric presentation and gritty criminal-business storytelling.
- Prioritize the core grow, harvest, sell, earn, upgrade, and expand loop, with original characters and a save system.

## Requirements
- Use a fixed angled 2.5D isometric view with colorful cartoon characters and an interactive, animated room.
- Include growing, harvesting, inventory, customer orders, money, upgrades, property expansion, employees, reputation, police attention, story choices, and save/load.
- Start in a small apartment and progress through larger operations toward an empire.
- Deliver a playable game without asking clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- Built as a self-contained HTML/CSS/JavaScript game with canvas-drawn isometric art; no external assets or dependencies.
- Used original characters and story beats: June, Vale, the Lark Street Collective, and an original multi-chapter storyline.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added `index.html` with responsive mobile/desktop UI, an animated isometric room, plant growth/harvesting, quality-based customer sales, cash and reputation, upgrades, crew, fronts, property expansion, police attention, story choices, and localStorage persistence.
- Corrected property expansion to charge the current property’s price, and added passive income for the Wash & Fold front.
- Ran `node --check` successfully on extracted game JavaScript.
- Opened the app in Playwright and confirmed planting updates inventory/cash and the story modal opens.
- Captured a JPEG screenshot at `/tmp/opencode/green-empire.jpg`.

### Active
- Final review of the most recent edits; the last story epilogue and favicon edits were made after the browser check.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Re-run a quick browser check after the final edits, including story progression and expansion cost.
2. Check `git status` and report the delivered game and any assumptions; no commit or push has been made.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Complete game implementation.
- `/tmp/opencode/green-empire.jpg`: Browser screenshot captured during verification.

## Important Context
- A local static server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- The browser test changed browser-local game progress by planting a cutting; no game save data was written to the repository.
